meta.title: ERP-Driven Master Creation: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Switching between an unnamed Growth tenant and an Enterprise tenant while keeping the same Tenant Admin identity.
Using ERP-Driven Master Creation to auto-create material and service records from inbound ERP purchase requisitions.
Observing that the capability is absent or refused on Growth and available and successful on Enterprise.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Switching between an unnamed Growth tenant and an Enterprise tenant while keeping the same Tenant Admin identity.; Using ERP-Driven Master Creation to auto-create material and service records from inbound ERP purchase requisitions.; Observing that the capability is absent or refused on Growth and available and successful on Enterprise.

steps.note: Closest available screen for inspecting purchase requisitions, but it does not expose ERP-driven master creation or plan-gated availability.
Confirm the reachable Purchase Requisitions screen is usable before the missing plan comparison is performed.

args.need: sign in as the same Tenant Admin on a Growth tenant and an Enterprise tenant, run ERP-Driven Master Creation from inbound ERP purchase requisitions on both, and verify Growth is absent or refused while Enterprise succeeds

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to unnamed plan tiers or perform ERP-driven master creation, so tester interaction is required.
Provide a final assertion that the resulting screen is free of crashes or server errors, without treating it as evidence of plan availability.
